title: FCE Use of English Part 4 - Key Word Transformation (Present Perfect)
hint: Think about time expressions go with the present perfect and past simple verb tenses.
promptSentence: I haven't seen John for three weeks.

chunkFeedback.1: The fixed phrase is 'the last time' — always used with the past simple.
chunkFeedback.2: Past simple 'saw' is needed because 'the last time' is a past time period.

feedback.correct: Excellent! You successfully transformed the sentence from the present perfect to the past simple.
feedback.incorrect: Remember: 'I haven't seen John for three weeks' → 'The last time I saw John was three weeks ago'. Present perfect with 'for' changes to past simple with 'ago'.
